comparison.objective: Rinse designated teeth, coordinate suction to clear liquid, and return both tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tool positioning, distributed rinse coverage, liquid evacuation, and controlled tool return.
comparison.success_condition: Required crown coverage and delivered volume, bounded pooling/spill, high recovery, post-rinse clearance, and released tools on their stands.
comparison.reason: Although both penalize lost contents, this record tests coordinated irrigation and suction at fixed dental sites, not conveyor selection or level transport of a carton containing free rigid objects.
